title: Route every model call through one gateway
subtitle: A control plane between the agent runtime and the models keeps keys, limits and logs in one place.
alt: Three tiers: an agent runtime sends prompts and tool calls to an AI gateway that handles authentication, logging, rate limits, caching, retries and observability, which routes to model providers.
source: Pattern from the OpenCode, AI gateway and Workers AI reference; gateway tools as listed on /ai-ops/architecture.
